name: Spider-Man
description: Peter Parker, Your Friendly neighborhood Spider-Man. Nuff Said

name: Mary Jane Watson
description: Spider-Man/Peter Parker's long-time love interest

name: Gwen Stacy
description: The late love interest of Peter Parker. Eventually becomes a key figure in his life and legacy of Spider-Man.

name: Harry Osborn
description: Peter Parker's best friend and eventual foe. The son of Norman Osborn and eventual heir to the Oscorp empire

name: Kindred
description: A demonic entity tied to Peter Parker's deal with Mephisto, revealed to be Harry Osborn's soul corrupted — the central villain of Spencer's run.

name: Liz Allen
description: Peter Parker's high school crush. She later marries Harry Osborn and becomes the mother of Normie Osborn

name: Flash Thompson
description: Peter Parker's high school bully and one of Spider-Man's biggest fans. Later turns into a close friend to Peter and eventually becomes Agent Venom

name: Sha Shan
description: A Vietnamese woman connected to Flash Thompson's past in the Vietnam War

name: Uncle Ben
description: Peter Parker's late uncle, who died tragically in a robbery that Peter Parker witnessed and could've stopped. His death serves as the catalyst for Peter's transformation into Spider-Man and his commitment to using his great powers responsibly

name: Aunt May
description: Peter Parker's loving aunt and the closest thing he has to a parent. She raised Peter with her late husband Ben Parker after the death of his parents. She is a constant source of support and guidance for him

name: Ben Reilly
description: The Scarlet Spider and clone of Peter Parker, debuting in Web of Spider-Man #118 as the Spider-Clone returns to New York during the Clone Saga. He later takes on the mantle of Spider-Man

name: Kaine
description: A degenerate clone of Peter Parker with precognitive spider-sense and corrosive touch. Later becomes an antihero and takes up the mantle of the Scarlet Spider.

name: Spider-Man 2099
description: Miguel O'Hara, a geneticist from the year 2099 who becomes Spider-Man of the future Neuva York

name: Silk
description: Cindy Moon, bitten by the same radioactive spider as Peter Parker, who spent years locked away and debuts during Spider-Verse.

name: Spider-Gwen
description: Gwen Stacy from an alternate universe where she was bitten by the radioactive spider instead of Peter, first appearing in Spider-Verse.

name: Burglar
description: The man responsible for the murder of Uncle Ben

name: Captain Stacy
description: George Stacy, a retired NYPD captain and father of Gwen Stacy

name: Jean DeWolff
description: NYPD captain and longtime Spider-Man ally whose murder by the Sin-Eater sets off one of the most acclaimed Spectacular Spider-Man arcs.

name: Crusher Hogan
description: A big time wrestler who Peter Parker fought in his first public appearance as Spider-Man

name: J. Jonah Jameson
description: The editor-in-chief of the Daily Bugle, possibly one of Spider-Man's greatest antagonists. He is obsessed with portraying Spider-Man as a wall crawling menace

name: Joe Robertson
description: Joseph 'Robbie' Robertson, the editor of the Daily Bugle and a close friend of Peter Parker

name: Betty Brant
description: J. Jonah Jameson's secretary and occasional love interest of Peter Parker in the early years. She later becomes a reporter for the Daily Bugle and marries Ned Leeds

name: Ned Leeds
description: Daily Bugle reporter and husband of Betty Brant, later revealed to be the Hobgoblin

name: Ben Urich
description: Investigative reporter for the Daily Bugle who frequently crosses paths with Spider-Man and Daredevil uncovering criminal conspiracies.

name: Eddie Brock
description: A disgraced journalist who bonds with the alien symbiote to become Venom, one of Spider-Man's greatest foes

name: John Jameson
description: World renowned astronaut and son of J. Jonah Jameson. Later becomes the Man Wolf

name: Madame Web
description: Cassandra Webb, a powerful psychic and clairvoyant who is connected to a life support system resembling a spider web

name: Black Cat
description: Felcia Hardy, Spider-Man's on-again off-again love interest who always sturs some sort of trouble in both Peter Parker and Spider-Man's lives

name: Silver Sable
description: Silver Sablinova, leader of the Wild Pack and a mercenary who hunts war criminals

name: Puma
description: Thomas Fireheart, a Native American businessman who can transform into a puma-like creature

name: Ezekiel Sims
description: Mysterious businessman who obtained spider-powers through a totem ritual and serves as both mentor and dark mirror to Spider-Man.

name: Norman Osborn
description: CEO of Oscorp. The Green Goblin. Father of Harry Osborn. And one of Spider-Man's greatest villains

name: Red Goblin
description: Norman Osborn bonded with the Carnage symbiote, becoming the Red Goblin — the most dangerous version of the Green Goblin ever faced.

name: Doctor Octopus
description: Doctor Otto Octavius, A brilliant scientist with four mechanical arms fused to his body. The leader of the infamous Sinister Six and one of Spider-Man's most iconic villains. Later swaps his mind with Peter Parker's to become the Superior Spider-Man

name: Vulture
description: Adrian Toomes, An elderly engineer who uses a special harness to fly and commit crime. A founding member of the Sinister Six and one of Spider-Man's most iconic villains

name: Sandman
description: Flint Marko, a criminal who gained the ability to transform into sand. A founding member of the Sinister Six and one of Spider-Man's most iconic villains

name: Lizard
description: Dr. Curt Connors, a scientist who transforms into a reptilian monster. One of the most tragic villains in Marvel Comics

name: Electro
description: Maxwell Dillon, a villain with the ability to generate and control electricity. A founding member of the Sinister Six and one of Spider-Man's most iconic villains

name: Mysterio
description: Quentin Beck, a special effects artist turned master of illusion and supervillain. A founding member of the Sinister Six and one of Spider-Man's most iconic villains

name: Kraven the Hunter
description: Sergei Kravinoff, the world's greatest hunter obsessed with capturing and defeating the apex predator. A founding member of the Sinister Six and one of Spider-Man's most iconic villains

name: Chameleon
description: A supervillain known for his ability to change his appearance. Brother of Kraven the Hunter

name: Scorpion
description: Mac Gargan, a private investigator transformed into the Scorpion by J. Jonah Jameson. An iconic Spider-Man villain and later becomes the third Venom

name: Rhino
description: Aleksei Sytsevich, a criminal bonded to a rhinoceros-like suit giving him immense strength. An iconic Spider-Man villain

name: Shocker
description: Herman Schultz, a villain who uses vibro-shock gauntlets to commit crimes. An iconic Spider-Man villain

name: Venom
description: Eddie Brock bonded with the alien symbiote, creating one of Spider-Man's most terrifying villains

name: Carnage
description: Cletus Kasady bonded with the offspring of the Venom symbiote, becoming Carnage, one of Spider-Man's most dangerous foes

name: Anti-Venom
description: Eddie Brock bonded to a new white symbiote formed from his cancer-curing white blood cells. Hunts both Spider-Man and Venom.

name: Cletus Kasady
description: A homicidal serial killer who becomes Carnage after bonding with the Venom symbiote's offspring

name: Carnage Max
description: Cletus Kasady bonded with the Venom symbiote offspring, leading a gang of supervillains on a killing spree through New York in Maximum Carnage.

name: Hobgoblin
description: Roderick Kingsley, a fashion mogul who discovered the Green Goblin's hideout and became the Hobgoblin

name: Morbius
description: Dr. Michael Morbius, a biochemist turned living vampire after a failed experiment

name: Jackal
description: Miles Warren, a geneticist and former professor of Peter Parker who became obsessed with cloning

name: Morlun
description: An ancient, virtually unstoppable energy vampire who feeds on totemic avatars. One of Spider-Man's most physically threatening foes.

name: Tinkerer
description: Phineas Mason, A brilliant inventor who creates gadgets for supervillains

name: Kingpin
description: Wilson Fisk, the powerful crime lord of New York City. Villain to all of street-level Marvel heroes, including Spider-Man and Daredevil

name: Silvermane
description: Silvio Manfredi, an aging Maggia crime boss obsessed with regaining his youth

name: Hammerhead
description: A Maggia crime boss with a steel-reinforced skull who uses his head as a weapon

name: Master Planner
description: Doctor Octopus operating under a secret alias to steal technology

name: Big Man
description: Frederick Foswell, a Daily Bugle reporter who secretly led the Enforcers as the Big Man

name: Enforcers
description: A gang of criminals consisting of Ox, Montana, and Fancy Dan

name: Blackie Drago
description: A criminal who stole the Vulture's harness while they were both imprisoned and took up the mantle as the second Vulture

name: Bart Hamilton
description: Harry Osborn's psychiatrist who became the third Green Goblin

name: Prowler
description: Hobie Brown, a young inventor who created a suit to commit crimes before becoming a hero

name: Rocket Racer
description: Robert Farrell, a young man who uses a rocket-powered skateboard to commit crimes

name: Molten Man
description: Mark Raxton, Liz Allen's step-brother who was accidentally coated in a liquid metal alloy

name: Beetle
description: Abner Jenkins, a mechanic who became a supervillain using a stolen suit of armor

name: Boomerang
description: Fred Myers, a reformed villain who becomes Peter Parker's unlikely roommate and comedic foil throughout much of the Spencer run.

name: Sin-Eater
description: Stanley Carter, a corrupt cop turned serial killer who targets sinners. His murder of Jean DeWolff is one of the darkest Spider-Man stories ever told.

name: Crime Master
description: Nick Lewis, a crime lord who clashed with Spider-Man and the Green Goblin

name: Ringmaster
description: Maynard Tiboldt, leader of the Circus of Crime

name: Spider-Slayer
description: A series of robots built by Spencer Smythe and commissioned by J. Jonah Jameson to destroy Spider-Man

name: Cat Burglar
description: A thief who appeared in early Spider-Man stories

name: Man-Wolf
description: John Jameson transformed into a werewolf-like creature by a mystical moonstone

name: Kangaroo
description: Frank Oliver, a villain with kangaroo-like agility and strength

name: Schemer
description: Richard Fisk, the son of the Kingpin who disguised himself to take down his father

name: Gibbon
description: Martin Blank, a man with ape-like abilities who was manipulated by Kraven the Hunter

name: Looter
description: Norton G. Fester, a villain who gained super strength from a meteor

name: Smasher
description: A villain who appeared in the political storyline issues of Amazing Spider-Man

name: Disruptor
description: A politically motivated villain who clashed with Spider-Man in the early 1970s

name: Jigsaw
description: Billy Russo, a hitman whose face was disfigured by the Punisher

name: Tarantula
description: A South American mercenary with poisoned toe spikes on his boots

name: Mindworm
description: William Turner, a mutant with powerful telepathic abilities

name: Mirage
description: Desmond Charne, a villain who uses holographic technology to create illusions

name: Living Brain
description: A powerful robot built by International Computing Machines Corporation

name: Grizzly
description: Maxwell Markham, a criminal who wears a bear-like exoskeleton suit

name: Cyclone
description: André Gerard, a French criminal who uses a suit that generates powerful wind vortexes

name: Juggernaut
description: Cain Marko, step-brother of Professor X, an unstoppable force empowered by the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak

name: Black Fox
description: An aging jewel thief who repeatedly clashes with Spider-Man

name: Shriek
description: Sandra Deel, a villain with sonic powers and Carnage's love interest

name: Stunner
description: Angelina Brancale, a woman who projects a superhumanly powerful holographic form through Doctor Octopus's technology

name: Shathra
description: A spider-wasp totem and natural predator of the spider-totem. Hunts Spider-Man as part of the ancient totemic cycle.

name: Mephisto
description: Marvel's devil figure. Offers to save Aunt May's life in exchange for Peter and MJ's marriage in the infamous comic 'One More Day'

name: Lily Hollister / Menace
description: Harry Osborn's girlfriend who secretly becomes Menace after exposure to a Goblin formula, serving her father the villain Carlie's rival.

name: Carlie Cooper
description: NYPD forensic scientist and love interest for Peter Parker during the Brand New Day era.

name: Freak
description: A drug addict who accidentally injects stem cells and mutates into a series of increasingly powerful monster forms.

name: Ana Kravinoff
description: Kraven the Hunter's daughter, raised to be a remorseless killer. Buries Spider-Man alive as her initiation and leads the Grim Hunt.

name: Sasha Kravinoff
description: Kraven's wife and the architect of the Grim Hunt, orchestrating the ritual to resurrect her husband using Spider-Man's blood.

name: Vulture (Freak New)
description: A new, younger and more savage Vulture introduced during the Gauntlet, distinct from the original Adrian Toomes.

name: Spider-Queen
description: The Jackal's partner and primary antagonist of Spider-Island, who can control anyone with spider-powers.

name: Phil Urich / Hobgoblin
description: Former heroic Green Goblin who becomes the new murderous Hobgoblin, stealing the mantle to work for the Kingpin.

name: Agent Venom
description: Flash Thompson bonded to the Venom symbiote as a government black-ops soldier, using it as a force for good.

name: Max Modell
description: Head of Horizon Labs, Peter Parker's dream employer during the Big Time era, who champions Peter's scientific genius.

name: Superior Spider-Man
description: Doctor Octopus in Peter Parker's body, operating as a more aggressive and ruthless Spider-Man while Peter's ghost fights for control.

name: Goblin King
description: Norman Osborn rebranded as the Goblin King, orchestrating the Goblin Nation takeover of New York's underworld during Superior Spider-Man.

name: Anna Maria Marconi
description: Ock's love interest during Superior Spider-Man — a brilliant scientist whom Ock genuinely falls for, motivating his final sacrifice.

name: The Inheritors
description: A family of totem-hunters led by Solus who hunt Spider-totems across the multiverse, the primary antagonists of Spider-Verse.

name: Scorpio / Zodiac
description: The leader of the Zodiac criminal organization who targets Parker Industries in a global confrontation during the Scorpio Rising arc.

name: Sin-Eater (Resurrected)
description: Stanley Carter resurrected by Kindred as a supernatural enforcer who 'cleanses' villains by killing them, setting up Last Remains.

name: Teresa Parker
description: A woman who may be Peter Parker's sister, a spy introduced in the Spencer run who complicates Peter's understanding of his family.

name: Kraven the Hunter (Hunted)
description: Kraven returns to orchestrate the Hunted arc, trapping heroes and villains in Central Park for the ultimate hunt, seeking a worthy death.

name: Harry Osborn (Green Goblin II)
description: Harry Osborn's tragic arc as the second Green Goblin, culminating in his death in Spectacular Spider-Man #200.

name: Ultimate Spider-Man
description: The Ultimate Universe's Peter Parker — younger, more modern, and defined by Brian Michael Bendis's 160-issue run ending with his heroic death.

name: Ultimate Mary Jane
description: Peter's high school girlfriend and emotional anchor in the Ultimate universe. A journalist in training, more assertive than her 616 counterpart.

name: Ultimate Gwen Stacy
description: Peter's classmate and eventual girlfriend in the Ultimate universe, with a very different fate than her 616 counterpart.

name: Ultimate Green Goblin
description: The Ultimate Green Goblin — a Hulk-like monster rather than a masked villain, whose obsession with Peter Parker drives the entire Bendis run.

name: Ultimate Aunt May
description: Peter's guardian in the Ultimate universe, who eventually learns he is Spider-Man and becomes one of his greatest supporters.

name: Ultimate Nick Fury
description: The Ultimate universe's Nick Fury, the black Nick Fury who inspired the MCU version, heavily involved in Spider-Man's world.

name: Ultimate Venom
description: Eddie Brock in the Ultimate universe, where the symbiote is a cancer cure invented by Peter's father, making the bond deeply personal.

name: Ultimate Carnage
description: A female clone created from Peter Parker and the Venom symbiote in the Ultimate universe, with a very different origin from her 616 counterpart.

name: Ultimate Spider-Man Clone
description: One of several Peter Parker clones created in the Ultimate Clone Saga, each with distinct personalities and abilities.

name: Ultimate Hobgoblin
description: Harry Osborn as the Ultimate Hobgoblin, infected with a version of his father's Oz formula and becoming a monster.

name: Ultimate Kingpin
description: Wilson Fisk as the Ultimate Kingpin, a younger and more physically imposing crime lord whose conflict with Spider-Man drives the Learning Curve arc.

name: Ultimate Black Cat
description: Felicia Hardy in the Ultimate universe, a cat burglar whose Hollywood connections bring her into Peter's life.

name: Ultimate Doctor Octopus
description: Otto Octavius in the Ultimate universe, a former OsCorp scientist whose tentacles are fused to his spine, making him more dangerous and unstable.

name: Ultimate Spider-Man (2024)
description: An older, married Peter Parker in the rebooted Ultimate Universe — a family man working at the Daily Bugle who becomes Spider-Man later in life.

name: Ultimate Mary Jane (2024)
description: Peter's wife in the 2024 Ultimate Universe, aware of his Spider-Man identity from the start.

name: Ultimate Norman Osborn (2024)
description: The villain of the 2024 Ultimate Universe, pulling strings behind the scenes as Peter discovers his new world.

name: Ultimate Uncle Ben
description: Peter Parker's guardian whose murder galvanizes him to become Spider-Man. His death echoes throughout the entire Bendis run.

name: Ultimate Harry Osborn
description: Peter's best friend at Midtown High and son of Norman Osborn. His complicated arc culminates in his death as the Hobgoblin in Death of a Goblin.

name: Ultimate Flash Thompson
description: Peter's bully-turned-classmate who ironically becomes Spider-Man's biggest fan. A recurring presence throughout the Bendis run.

name: Ultimate Kong McFarlane
description: Flash's friend who suspects Peter is Spider-Man early in the run. More sympathetic than his 616 counterpart.

name: Ultimate Electro
description: Working for the Kingpin during Learning Curve, Ultimate Electro is one of Spider-Man's first serious physical threats.

name: Ultimate Enforcers
description: The Kingpin's muscle — Ox, Fancy Dan, and Montana — recurring antagonists during the Learning Curve era.

name: Ultimate Kraven
description: Reimagined as an Australian reality TV host who hunts Spider-Man for ratings in the Doctor Octopus arc.

name: Ultimate Captain Stacy
description: Gwen's father and NYPD captain, killed by a Spider-Man impostor — a tragedy that shapes Gwen's distrust of Peter.

name: Ultimate Elektra
description: A deadly assassin working for the Kingpin in the Cats & Kings era, who clashes with Spider-Man and Black Cat.

name: Ultimate Liz Allan
description: Peter's classmate whose latent mutant fire powers emerge in the Amazing Friends arc, leading her to join the X-Men.

name: Ultimate Kitty Pryde
description: An X-Man who becomes Peter's girlfriend during the Warriors-through-Death of a Goblin era, one of the run's most beloved supporting characters.

name: Ultimate Spider-Woman
description: A female clone of Peter Parker who escapes the Clone Saga and forges her own identity, eventually joining S.H.I.E.L.D.

name: Ultimate Kaine
description: A degenerate Peter Parker clone who becomes an antagonist in the Clone Saga, ultimately killed by S.H.I.E.L.D.

name: Ultimate Human Torch
description: Johnny Storm who moves into the Parker household after Ultimatum, becoming part of Peter's extended family in his final days.

name: Ultimate Iceman
description: Bobby Drake who takes refuge at the Parker house post-Ultimatum and fights alongside Peter in the Death of Spider-Man.

name: Ultimate Shocker
description: Herman Schultz, one of Spider-Man's early recurring villains in the Ultimate universe, first appearing in Learning Curve.

name: Ultimate Rhino
description: A super-powered villain who appears briefly in the Public Scrutiny arc, defeated by Iron Man before Spider-Man arrives.

name: Ultimate Iron Man
description: Tony Stark in the Ultimate universe, who defeats Rhino in the Public Scrutiny arc and later plays a role in the Death of Spider-Man.

name: Ultimate Wolverine
description: The Ultimate Wolverine who body-swaps with Peter Parker during the Superstars arc.

name: Ultimate Moon Knight
description: A vigilante who clashes with Spider-Man during the Warriors arc and joins Daredevil's underground alliance.

name: Ultimate Silver Sable
description: Leader of the Wild Pack hired by Roxxon to capture Spider-Man in the Silver Sable arc.

name: Ultimate Deadpool
description: Reimagined as a reality TV host who hunts mutants on Krakoa in the Deadpool arc.

name: Ultimate Morbius
description: A vampire hunter who fights alongside Spider-Man against vampirism in the Morbius arc.

name: Ultimate Daredevil
description: Matt Murdock who organizes the Ultimate Knights alliance against the Kingpin and later dies in the Ultimatum wave.

name: Ultimate Ned Leeds
description: A classmate of Peter Parker who first appears in the Omega Red issue (#121).

name: Ultimate Vulture
description: Adrian Toomes, introduced in The Worst Day in Peter Parker's Life (#122) as an enemy created by Roxxon.

name: Ultimate Beetle
description: First appears in #122, part of the War of the Symbiotes era as a villain working for Latveria.

name: Ultimate Firestar
description: Liz Allan's mutant fire powers manifest in the Amazing Friends arc (#118-120), leading her to be called Firestar.

name: Ultimate Omega Red
description: Appears in the Silver Sable arc and his own spotlight issue (#121).

name: Ultimate Jessica Jones
description: First appears in the Ultimate Knights arc (#106-110) as part of Daredevil's underground alliance against the Kingpin.

name: Ultimate Geldoff
description: A foreign exchange student with psionic car-exploding powers who appears in the Irresponsible arc (#40-45).

name: Ultimate Chameleon
description: The Ultimate Chameleon impersonates Peter Parker in the Vol 2 arc, nearly destroying his relationships and discovering his secret identity.

name: Ultimate Mysterio
description: The Ultimate Mysterio who appears post-Ultimatum as a new crime boss in New York, confronting Spider-Man in the Tainted Love arc.

name: Ultimate Shang-Chi
description: Master martial artist who joins Daredevil's Ultimate Knights alliance against the Kingpin in the Warriors arc.

name: Ultimate Iron Fist
description: Danny Rand who joins the Ultimate Knights alongside Daredevil, Shang-Chi and Spider-Man. Acts as an informant for the Kingpin which nearly derails the alliance.

name: Ultimate Ronin
description: Moon Knight's Ronin persona created to infiltrate the Kingpin's operation as a bodyguard in the Ultimate Knights arc.

name: Ultimate Captain America
description: Steve Rogers in the Ultimate universe — harder and more moralistic than his 616 counterpart. Finds Peter after Ultimatum and trains him briefly before the Death of Spider-Man.

name: Ultimate Thor
description: The Ultimate Thor who appears in the Spidey's 50th Anniversary special debating what to do about Spider-Man alongside Captain America and Iron Man.

name: Ultimate Carol Danvers
description: S.H.I.E.L.D. director who takes over from Fury and plays a key role in the Death of a Goblin and Superhero Training arcs, ordering Peter's training.

name: Ultimate Punisher
description: Frank Castle who shoots Spider-Man during the Death of Spider-Man arc while trying to kill Captain America, setting off Peter's final battle.

name: Ultimate Sandman
description: One of the Sinister Six assembled by Norman Osborn who attacks the Parker house during the Death of Spider-Man.

name: Ultimate Electro (Sinister Six)
description: Electro who is broken out by Norman Osborn and attacks Peter's home in the Death of Spider-Man, ultimately neutralized by Aunt May's gun shot.

name: Ultimate Jean Grey
description: X-Man who appears when Spider-Man visits the X-Mansion during the Irresponsible arc.

name: Ultimate Professor X
description: Xavier who hosts Spider-Man at the X-Mansion during the Irresponsible arc and informs him about Geldoff's origin.

name: Ultimate Fantastic Four
description: Reed, Sue, Johnny and Ben who assist Spider-Man during the Clone Saga when the situation at the Parker house escalates beyond his control.

name: Ultimate Venom (2024)
description: Peter and MJ's 15-year-old son who inherits the picotech suit when Peter goes missing and adopts the name Venom.

name: Ultimate May Parker (2024)
description: Peter and MJ's younger daughter, the first to discover Peter's Spider-Man identity and suggest the red and blue suit.

name: Ultimate Uncle Ben (2024)
description: Peter's uncle who is alive in this timeline. Managing editor of the Daily Bugle before quitting with Jonah to found The Paper.

name: Ultimate J. Jonah Jameson (2024)
description: Ben Parker's newspaper partner who co-founds The Paper after leaving the Bugle. Friend and ally throughout the series.

name: Ultimate Gwen Stacy (2024)
description: Harry's wife and Oscorp CEO, secretly a member of the Mysterio group. Fakes Harry's death to protect him and ultimately turns on the Sinister Six.

name: Ultimate Green Goblin (2024)
description: Peter's closest ally and the armored vigilante Green Goblin. Married to Gwen Stacy, he fights alongside Spider-Man against Kingpin's Sinister Six.

name: Ultimate Doctor Octopus (2024)
description: Oscorp scientist who helps Peter and Harry, eventually building his own Spider-Man suit. Designed after Otto's Elliot Tolliver clone form.

name: Ultimate Iron Lad (2024)
description: Leader of The Ultimates who sends Peter the radioactive spider and sets him on the path to becoming Spider-Man.

name: Ultimate Kingpin (2024)
description: Shadow Governor of Manhattan serving the Maker's Council. Assembles the Sinister Six to eliminate Spider-Man and Green Goblin. Dies falling from Fisk Tower.

name: Ultimate Shocker (2024)
description: Herman Schultz, a bank robber who accidentally received his vibro-gauntlets from a package meant for Peter Parker.

name: Ultimate Kraven (2024)
description: Billionaire hunter who controls Staten Island for the Sinister Six. Kidnaps Peter and Harry for a lethal hunt in Subterranea before being shot by Mysterio.

name: Ultimate Mister Negative (2024)
description: Martin Li, CEO of F.E.A.S.T. and leader of the Demons gang. Controls Queens for the Sinister Six before turning on Kingpin and dying with him.

name: Ultimate Mole Man (2024)
description: Harvey Elder, Kingpin's oldest ally who rules Subterranea. Eventually defects and aids Spider-Man against Kingpin.

name: Ultimate Mysterio (2024)
description: A secret group of illusion-powered heroes including Gwen Stacy, Quentin Beck, Robbie Robertson, and James Wesley who oppose the Maker's Council.

name: Ultimate Black Cat Sr. (2024)
description: Fisk's lieutenant who controls the Bronx. Paralyzed by Green Goblin, replaced by his daughter Felicia.

name: Ultimate Black Cat (2024)
description: Walter Hardy's 16-year-old daughter who takes over as the new Black Cat. Befriends Richard Parker II and ultimately helps Spider-Man against Kingpin.

name: Ultimate Bullseye (2024)
description: An assassin group serving the Maker's Council and Kingpin, devoted to Henri Duggary.

name: Ultimate Sandman (2024)
description: William Baker, transformed by AIM experimentation. Briefly attacks the Parker family before being freed by Spider-Man and becoming an ally.

name: Captain America
description: Steve Rogers, scrawny kid from Brooklyn, transformed into a super-soldier during World War II. A leader of the Avengers and one of Marvel's most iconic heroes.

name: Iron Man
description: Tony Stark; billionaire, playboy, philanthropist, etc. Owner of Stark Industries and founding member of the Avengers.

name: Hulk
description: Bruce Banner, a scientist who transforms into a green-skinned giant of immense strength

name: Black Widow
description: Natasha Romanoff, a former Soviet spy turned S.H.I.E.L.D. agent and Avenger

name: Mister Fantastic
description: Reed Richards, One of the worlds most brilliant scientists and the leader of the Fantastic Four. Husband of Sue Storm and father of Franklin Richards and Valeria Richards

name: Invisible Woman
description: Susan Storm. Wife of Reed Richards and the first lady of Marvel, and of the Fantastic Four

name: Human Torch
description: Johnny Storm. The hot headed younger brother of Sue Storm and uncle to Franklin Richards and Valeria Richards

name: Thing
description: Ben Grimm, best friend of Reed Richards and the strongest member of the Fantastic Four

name: Doctor Doom
description: Victor Von Doom, ruler of Latveria and one of Marvel's greatest villains. Arch enemy of the Fantastic Four and Mister Fantastic.

name: Daredevil
description: Matt Murdock, a blind lawyer who fights crime as the Man Without Fear

name: Punisher
description: Frank Castle, a vigilante who wages a one-man war on crime after the murder of his family

name: Luke Cage
description: A street-level hero with unbreakable skin and superhuman strength, also known as Power Man

name: Wolverine
description: Logan, a mutant with adamantium claws and a berserker rage. Member of the X-Men

name: Iceman
description: Bobby Drake, a mutant with the ability to generate and control ice

name: Nightcrawler
description: Kurt Wagner, a blue-skinned mutant X-Man with teleportation abilities

name: Quicksilver
description: Pietro Maximoff, a mutant with the ability to move at superhuman speeds

name: Medusa
description: Medusalith Amaquelin, queen of the Inhumans with prehensile hair

name: Doctor Strange
description: Stephen Strange, the Sorcerer Supreme and master of the mystic arts

name: Spider-Woman
description: Jessica Drew, a longtime Avenger and spy who plays a key role in coordinating the Spider-Army during Spider-Verse.

name: Ka-Zar
description: Kevin Plunder, a lord of the jungle who rules over the Savage Land

name: Batman
description: Bruce Wayne, the Dark Knight of Gotham

name: Robin
description: Dick Grayson, the Boy Wonder and protégé of Batman

name: Invincible
description: Mark Grayson, a teenager whose father comes from the Planet Viltrum

name: Hellboy
description: Half-demon from the B.P.R.D.
